text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

words.gloss_range: narrated saying that opens a quoted supplication; plain declared speech rather than dispute, fabrication, or a narrator command
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, declaring, and articulated position, with derived branches for disputation or fabricated attribution not selected by the local Form I perfect
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) turns the scene from the people's public challenge into a reported prayer. Its singular perfect form routes the speech to one prophetic speaker before the quotation opens, while the following prayer remains the live request inside that quoted space. The word also joins a familiar speech-to-Lord prayer frame, with a same-surah prayer link at 29:26, and answers nearby plural speech turns (29:28; 29:29) by changing the channel from human argument to appeal.

topics.headline: singular speaker routed before quotation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the utterance is anchored to one prophetic speaker before the prayer begins, not left as anonymous supplication.
topics.reason: The local perfect verb carries 3ms agreement and governs the quoted span; boundary evidence makes the move from public assembly to solitary prayer coherent.

topics.headline: narration yields to direct supplication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's action happening through reported speech: narration opens, then the quoted imperative performs the request.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following vocative and imperative as the utterance governed by the speech verb, so the prayer architecture belongs inside the quotation.

topics.headline: plain saying, not dispute or fabrication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a declared appeal rather than another round of disputation with the people.
topics.reason: The wider speech root can support dispute or fabricated-attribution derivatives, but the local Form I perfect selects ordinary reported saying.

topics.headline: speech-to-Lord formula answers prior speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening does not merely start a sentence; it moves from prior defiant speech (29:29) into a recognized prophetic prayer register, with a nearby same-surah prayer link (29:26).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows name concrete same-surah and formulaic links, and the local adjacency to the Lord-vocative realizes the speech-to-Lord frame.

topics.headline: minor hard-onset sound note
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The consonantal-onset observation adds little beyond the retained turn-opening and prayer-transition topics.
topics.reason: The row is sound-texture color without a distinct lexical or structural payoff after the speech-frame topics.

words.gloss_range: possessive vocative title, my Lord, setting a direct Lord-supplicant relation before the aid request
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, mastery, ownership, sustaining care, nurture, and bringing matters to completion; local grammar selects the possessed divine title
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّ}} ({{tr:rabbi}}) is the relation-setting center of the prayer. The possessed vocative makes the addressee direct and personal before any request is voiced, so the imperative that follows is not unaddressed force but petition to the speaker's Lord. The compact one-word address carries urgency, while variant pressure around the title shows how syntactically loaded the word is even though the local canonical reading remains vocative. The title also carries sustaining authority against disorder, and the compact address joins the recurring prophetic plea pattern visible at 23:26 and 23:39.

topics.headline: direct possessed vocative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plea begins from a personal Lord-supplicant relation, not from a detached divine title.
topics.reason: Local syntax marks the word as vocative, and morphology supplies a first-person possessive relation inside the address.

topics.headline: compressed one-word address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the prayer's urgency in the one-word address beat before the request moves forward.
topics.reason: The expected vocative relation is present without extra visible introductory material, producing a compact address before the imperative.

topics.headline: authority and nurture in the Lord-title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the requested aid is addressed to sustaining Lordship, making the plea for order against corruptors more than a generic call for power.
topics.reason: The local word is a title, not a verbal action, so the broader nurture and governance field survives as title pressure rather than as a separate event.

topics.headline: variant-sensitive syntactic pressure point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why this short title is syntactically loaded: variant evidence can reopen its clause role even though the local canonical reading remains vocative.
topics.reason: The accepted variant is useful as contrast, but the aligned local grammar keeps the canonical form as a vocative address.

topics.headline: recurring prophetic plea formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the address as part of a repeated prophetic crisis formula, especially with matching appeals at 23:26 and 23:39.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete formula parallels, and the local address plus following imperative realizes that pattern.

words.gloss_range: direct imperative petition for aid to the speaker, sharpened by the following preposition into help against an adversary
words.root_gloss_range: aid, support, defense, making prevail, victory, with other branches such as self-vindication, alliance, rain, and named or religious derivatives not locally selected
words.prose: {{ar:ٱنصُرْنِى}} ({{tr:unṣurnī}}) is the ayah's action hinge. The imperative makes the speech a direct petition, and the attached first-person object places Lūṭ himself inside the verb as beneficiary. With the following adversarial preposition, the request becomes help-against, not help in the abstract; it asks for external support from the addressed Lord rather than self-vindication. The wording also answers the prior bring-us-punishment dare (29:29) by moving onto an aid axis and matches prophetic rescue-prayer patterns at 23:26 and 23:39.

topics.headline: direct command with first-person beneficiary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the request is not merely about aid; the speaker is grammatically built into the imperative as its beneficiary.
topics.reason: The verb is a 2ms imperative with a 1s object suffix, and attachment evidence marks that suffix as the direct object of the imperative.

topics.headline: help-against construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verb's request become a conflict frame: aid is requested for the speaker against a defined people.
topics.reason: The local frame has a clitic object plus an adversarial prepositional complement, and the contextual profile identifies that preposition as the top command-form partner for this root.

topics.headline: external divine aid, not self-redress
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices dependency: Lūṭ does not claim the power to vindicate himself but asks the addressed Lord to supply aid.
topics.reason: The wider derivational family includes self-vindication and mutual assistance, but the local Form I imperative addressed to the Lord selects direct requested aid.

topics.headline: recurring rescue-prayer formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears Lūṭ's request as part of a repeated prophetic rescue-prayer pattern, especially the matching help-against formula at 23:26 and 23:39.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL evidence supplies concrete parallels and same-surah aid language; the local command plus adversarial complement realizes the formula.

topics.headline: prior dare redirected into supplication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the previous demand for punishment (29:29) answered by prayer for aid, not by adopting the challengers' terms.
topics.reason: Boundary rows identify the shift from the prior challenge to the vertical request, and local grammar makes the imperative the center of that shift.

topics.headline: minor internal cadence anticipation
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The cadence note does not add a separate lexical or structural payoff beyond the retained request-to-adversary hinge.
topics.reason: The row is audible texture rather than an independent aha topic.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the target phrase as an adversarial complement, against/over, rather than a neutral spatial upon
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) is the small word that turns the request into help-against. It governs the following people phrase and makes that whole phrase the adversary of the aid request, not a neutral topic. Its ordinary overness is narrowed here by the aid construction into victory-over force, and its position after the imperative delays the naming of the adversary until the petition has already been voiced. Against the prior conditional dare (29:29), the phrase redirects the crisis into supplication against the challengers rather than compliance with their terms.

topics.headline: preposition governs the adversary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are grammatically introduced as the opposing side of the aid request.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the governed noun phrase under the preposition as the complement of the imperative.

topics.headline: overness narrowed by aid context
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the against-sense as more than a flat marker; it carries victory-over pressure while local grammar blocks a merely spatial reading.
topics.reason: The broader prepositional range includes spatial overness, but the local aid construction selects adversarial againstness with victory-over coloring.

topics.headline: compact pivot from beneficiary to adversary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how one invariant particle pivots the clause from the speaker's need to the hostile group.
topics.reason: The particle has no suffix or inflection, but it controls the case and relation of the following phrase.

topics.headline: prior challenge redirected into prayer against them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior conditional dare (29:29) resolves as a supplication against the challengers rather than as compliance with their demand.
topics.reason: The boundary row is concrete and the local prepositional phrase supplies the adversarial target.

words.gloss_range: the identifiable people as a governed collective adversary, immediately qualified by the corruption participle
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, establishing, maintaining, straightening, and communal standing-together; local noun selects a collective people rather than abstract uprightness or unrelated derivative branches
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَوْمِ}} ({{tr:al-qawmi}}) identifies the adversary as a known collective body, not scattered individuals. Its genitive case keeps that group governed by the preceding preposition, while the following participle locks the corruption label onto the same people. The root's standing-community pressure makes the next label sharper: a body that should stand together is named as a corrupting community. The same people-and-corruption pairing participates in a corrupt-community formula at 7:86 and in the same-surah corruption pattern at 29:36. The word also changes the prior people-frame (29:29) by dropping the possessive tie and making the group the adversary in the prayer.

topics.headline: known people governed as adversary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the target is a known people placed under the adversarial preposition, not an acting subject or vague group.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and genitive because it is governed by the preposition in the aid-against construction.

topics.headline: head noun receives corruption attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the adversary built in two steps: community first, then the qualifying corruption charge.
topics.reason: Agreement and local syntax mark the following participle as an adjective of the same definite genitive head noun.

topics.headline: standing community under corruption label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony of a standing collective being characterized by disordering action.
topics.reason: The local noun means people or community, while the broader standing and establishment field survives as image-pressure sharpened by the following corruption label.

topics.headline: people-and-corruption formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as more than a local description: it participates in a corrupt-community formula also visible at 7:86 and in the same-surah corruption pattern at 29:36.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete formula and co-occurrence links; local head-plus-attribute structure realizes the pair.

topics.headline: his-people frame becomes adversary group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the relational shift from his people in the preceding exchange (29:29) to the people as a governed adversary.
topics.reason: Boundary rows identify the root handoff, and local grammar confirms that the possessive relation has been replaced by a definite adversarial complement.

words.gloss_range: definite plural Form IV active participle naming the known group as active agents of corruption within the adversary phrase
words.root_gloss_range: spoiling, corruption, decay, invalidity, disorder, and causing things to become unsound; local Form IV participle selects causative corrupting agency
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ}} ({{tr:al-mufsidīna}}) closes the ayah by giving the adversary its reason-name. As a definite plural active participle, it identifies the people by an ongoing corrupting quality rather than by one fresh event, and its agreement keeps the label attached to the governed people phrase. The Form IV shape makes them agents who cause disorder, while the root's spoilage field lets corruption feel like sound things being made rotten, invalid, or broken. The land-corruption association remains relevant background, but because no land-domain is stated here, the label lands directly on the people; same-surah and cross-surah echoes at 29:36 and 7:86 make that final diagnosis formulaic.

topics.headline: definite participle as identity label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word names a standing identity of corrupting agency, not a single reported act.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a definite plural active participle, and contextual data show this exact form class as a constrained identity label.

topics.headline: corruption label locked to the head noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the corruption label belongs to the same adversary group inside the prepositional phrase.
topics.reason: Agreement in definiteness and genitive case marks the participle as an adjective of the governed head noun rather than a separate apposition.

topics.headline: causing corruption, not merely being spoiled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final charge as active damage: the people are dangerous because they make things unsound.
topics.reason: The broader root includes spoilage and disorder, but the local Form IV active participle selects causative agency rather than a merely stative corrupt condition.

topics.headline: land-corruption association without stated land domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the familiar land-corruption background in view while noticing that this ayah attaches the charge directly to the people.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence claim is real as background, but the local wording does not state a land-domain phrase, so the charge remains a direct attribute of the group.

topics.headline: final diagnosis joins corruption-community pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the final label as a prophetic corruption diagnosis tied to same-surah 29:36 and the corrupt-people formula at 7:86.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah and cross-surah echoes, and the local head-plus-participle phrase realizes the formula.

topics.headline: final word carries closure weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah land on the corruption label as the compressed explanation for the whole plea.
topics.reason: The participle is the final word and the adjective completing the target phrase, so it carries the clause's explanatory burden.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative 'help me' is governed by 'my Lord' and directed against a people named by active corruption.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken petition transfers the conflict to sovereign authority, asks for aid that makes one side prevail, and identifies the opposing collective functionally by its production of disorder.

activation_trace.role: Spoken articulation supplies the utterance and functions as a formal petition rather than an unvoiced wish.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the addressee and locate decisive authority beyond the speaker.
Aid and making-prevail supply the requested action and function as intervention in an asymmetrical conflict.
A human collective supplies the social scale and functions as the opposed body.
Departure from soundness and balance supplies the predicate that functionally defines the opposed collective.

changed_reading.before: A bare request for victory over enemies.
changed_reading.after: A formal appeal to sovereign aid against a collective identified by its active production of disorder.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence Lord, help, people, and corrupters permits repair, support, social standing, and loss of soundness to form one focus-only model.
baseline_models.mechanism: Corruption damages what lets a social body stand; aid from the Lord who repairs and completes can therefore mean restoration of the collective's qiwam, not only removal of opponents.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion supply a restorative agency and function as the mode of lordly response.
Aid and manifestation supply effective support and function as the means of restoration.
Qiwam as supporting structure and means of subsistence supplies the system that corruption has made fail.
Loss of soundness and proportion supplies the damage-state and functions as the condition to be repaired.

changed_reading.after: Restore the social supports and proportion that active corruption has made unable to stand.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction 'help me against' activates the redress branch of the focus imperative even though the focus alone does not state the prior injury.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker appeals to the sovereign for the oppressed party's vindication against agents whose corruption has displaced right order.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign mastery supplies jurisdiction and functions as the authority from whom redress is sought.
The oppressed party's vindication and recovery of right supply a juridical image for the requested help.
Active displacement from soundness supplies the wrong-making condition against which redress operates.

changed_reading.after: Secure redress for the wronged party by reversing corruption's displacement of right order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Testing separates truthful from lying claims, while 29:10 makes the arrival of support the occasion for retrospective claims of solidarity; support can thus expose alignment as well as alter power.

activation_trace.role: Aid that makes a side manifest supplies the focus action and functions as the event whose diagnostic effect is being tested.
Assaying metal or persons supplies a sorting image and functions as the process that tests stated allegiance.
Truthfulness of speech supplies one assay outcome and functions as durable correspondence between claim and stance.
Contradiction of truth supplies the other assay outcome and functions as exposed misalignment.
The two spoken claims supply inspectable declarations and function as the before-and-after record of opportunistic affiliation.
Arrived aid and manifestation supply the conditional turning point and function as the event that elicits 'we were with you.'

structural_cues: 29:2-3 frame profession as a test that becomes truthful or lying.
29:10 places human affliction, arrived support from the Lord, and a renewed solidarity claim in one conditional sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, opposed truth outcomes, and a claim made when support arrives; I infer that support itself reveals allegiance. A live alternative is that support merely rewards a distinction already completed by testing.

changed_reading.before: Help changes only the external balance between speaker and opponents.
changed_reading.after: Help also makes hidden or unstable allegiances publicly legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Route severance and normalized wrong in the public assembly show corruption operating through shared infrastructure; its recurrence as an earth-directed prohibition to another people makes 'corrupters' a repeatable social role rather than an ethnic essence.

activation_trace.role: The collective supplies the focus's social body and functions as the carrier, not the essence, of the named conduct.
Causing departure from soundness supplies the focus predicate and functions as a role defined by effects.
Road-cutting by seizure or obstruction supplies a concrete network failure and functions as corruption of circulation.
An extended traversable path supplies the shared conduit and functions as what collective action disables.
The people's council and gathering supply a public institution and function as the site where wrong is normalized.
Repellent wrong supplies the assembly's practice and functions as socially ratified disorder.
Earth as the lower inhabited domain supplies the scale across which the conduct has consequences.
The repeated plural corrupters supplies a cross-episode conduct label and functions as evidence that the category can recur in another people.

structural_cues: 29:29 coordinates severing the path and doing wrong in the assembly immediately before the collective's challenge.
29:36 applies the same corrupter form within a warning addressed to a different people and tied to conduct in the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked circulation, public normalization, and a trans-episode recurrence of the label; I infer a networked functional class. A live alternative is that these are merely separate offenses attached to separate peoples.

changed_reading.before: The corrupting people are a homogeneous enemy population.
changed_reading.after: They are agents sustaining a public system of blocked movement and normalized wrong, so opposition targets functions and conduct rather than peoplehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people's answer demands punishment, the focus replies by petitioning the Lord, and the following declarations pair destruction with rescue and an exception inside the household; help becomes sovereign adjudication that sorts rather than simply reverses two blocs.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign lordship supplies jurisdiction and functions as the authority to whom the challenged case is transferred.
Vindication of the wronged supplies the focus request and functions as adjudicative redress.
A returned answer in speech supplies the people's counter-move and functions as the challenge that the focus petition supersedes.
Painful punishment supplies the demanded proof and functions as the proposed criterion of truthfulness.
Falling into destruction supplies one declared outcome and functions as judgment on the oppressive settlement.
Escape by separation supplies the paired outcome and functions as selective extraction rather than mass reversal.
Nearness and affiliation supply the household boundary and function as a boundary that judgment tests rather than blindly honors.
A remainder left after others pass supplies the exception and functions as evidence that even the household is internally sorted.

structural_cues: The sequence is challenge in 29:29, petition in 29:30, then announced destruction in 29:31 and rescue in 29:32-33.
The rescue-and-wife exception is repeated in both 29:32 and 29:33.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency plus paired destruction, rescue, and household exception; I infer that the petition hands the challenge to sovereign adjudication. A live alternative is that the following arrival is narrative succession without the prayer being marked as its causal hinge.

changed_reading.before: Victory means one whole people defeating another whole people.
changed_reading.after: Divine help is a judgment that separates outcomes across settlement and household boundaries, vindicating without treating affiliation as innocence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Adorned deeds produce diversion from the path even among those described by sight; corruption can therefore persist through attractive valuation and misused perception, making exposure a form of aid.

activation_trace.role: Departure from soundness supplies the focus diagnosis and functions here as the result of distorted valuation.
Making something appear beautiful supplies the attractive surface and functions as the mediation that hides damage.
Turning aside and diverting supply the motion and function as obstruction without literal road destruction.
The traversable path supplies right-directed movement and functions as what beautified action blocks.
Insight of the heart supplies available perception and functions as the troubling capacity that adornment can still misdirect.

structural_cues: 29:38 places beautified works, diversion from the path, and being perceptive in one sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adornment, path-diversion, and perception; I infer that false valuation converts sight into complicity and that unmasking it can answer the focus plea. A live alternative is that 'perceptive' denotes worldly competence rather than available moral insight.

changed_reading.before: Support must overcome an openly recognizable external evil.
changed_reading.after: Support may expose attractive practices whose beauty sustains blockage even among people capable of seeing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's appeal to the Lord for help is sharpened by the image of allied protectors forming a structurally weak shelter: divine support is not one more patron inside the same network but an alternative ground of protection.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign lordship supplies the true governing relation and functions as the alternative to acquired patrons.
Aid and making-prevail supply effective protection and function as the reality contrasted with apparent alliance.
Alliance, love, and support supply the counterfeit protective relation and function as the social promise under examination.
Shelter and dwelling supply the protective structure and function as the material analogy for an alliance network.
Weakness of force and resolve supplies the structure's failure and functions as the exposure of false security.

structural_cues: 29:41 explicitly compares adopted protectors to the weakest house.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies patronage, shelter, and structural weakness; I infer that the focus appeal exits a counterfeit support architecture. A live alternative is that the comparison concerns worship generally without specifying the social structure of Lot's opponents.

changed_reading.before: The speaker seeks a stronger ally within a contest of alliances.
changed_reading.after: The speaker rejects the opponents' entire architecture of patronage and seeks protection grounded in sovereign lordship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later discourse makes best-form engagement the default and marks an exception by wrongdoing; this constrains 'against the corrupting people' to active injustice rather than authorizing indiscriminate hostility toward a named community.

activation_trace.role: The collective supplies the potentially overbroad object and functions as the category that requires ethical constraint.
Active production of disorder supplies a conduct predicate and functions as the narrower basis of opposition.
Intertwined disputation supplies the engagement domain and functions as conduct governed by a stated manner.
Goodness opposed to ugliness supplies the default manner and functions as restraint on adversarial engagement.
Withholding or blocking right supplies the exception criterion and functions as conduct, not identity, that changes the response.

structural_cues: 29:46 uses an exception to require the best manner, then another exception keyed to those who wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a default manner and a conduct-based exception; I infer that the focus's collective opposition is likewise predicate-bounded. A live alternative is that 29:46 regulates only argument with another audience and does not directly limit the Lot episode.

changed_reading.before: Being against the people permits undifferentiated hostility toward the whole group.
changed_reading.after: Resistance is keyed to active corruption and injustice, while engagement remains bounded by the best available manner.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later echo of demanded punishment distinguishes petition from timetable: an appointed term blocks human acceleration, while suddenness and already-surrounding consequence preserve certainty without granting the petitioner control of when aid appears.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign lordship supplies control of the case and functions here as control of its timing.
Requested aid supplies the hoped-for intervention and functions as an entrusted outcome rather than a scheduled command.
Acceleration and bringing forward supply the opponents' temporal demand and function as the pressure explicitly denied control.
Painful punishment supplies the repeated demanded event and functions as the delayed but certain consequence.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the governing schedule and functions as the barrier to human acceleration.
Sudden arrival supplies the eventual mode and functions as certainty without predictability.
Overwhelming enclosure supplies an already-operative consequence and functions as latency rather than absence.

structural_cues: 29:29 demands punishment as proof, while 29:53-54 twice describes hastening that punishment and counters it with an appointed term and encompassing consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated demand, fixed term, surprise, and enclosure; I infer that the focus plea entrusts timing rather than demanding immediacy. A live alternative is that these later verses answer a different audience's haste without qualifying Lot's request.

changed_reading.before: The imperative asks the Lord to intervene at once on the speaker's schedule.
changed_reading.after: The imperative entrusts a certain but sovereignly timed intervention whose latency is not failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A safe inviolable center amid surrounding seizure offers a non-conquest form of aid: support can interrupt predation by establishing a protected social space rather than by eliminating everyone outside it.

activation_trace.role: Effective aid supplies the focus request and functions here as protection made spatially manifest.
A spatial sanctuary and protected precinct supply the bounded center and function as an interruption of ordinary predation.
Heart-settling safety supplies the center's condition, while the root's second occurrence makes that security a test of trust.
Swift seizure supplies the surrounding threat and functions as the predatory circulation from which the center is exempted.
The directions around a thing supply the contrastive perimeter and function as the exposed outside of the protected zone.

structural_cues: 29:67 places a safe sanctuary inside a surrounding field where people are being snatched away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sanctuary, safety, seizure, and a surrounding perimeter; I infer that protected space is one modal answer to the focus request. A live alternative is that the verse demonstrates ingratitude for an existing sanctuary rather than explaining support against corrupters.

changed_reading.before: Help can only mean attacking the corrupting collective.
changed_reading.after: Help may establish an inviolable zone whose safety breaks the surrounding pattern of seizure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's final conditional joins strenuous effort to promised guidance into paths and divine accompaniment; aid can operate as direction and ongoing presence through action, not only as an external override.

activation_trace.role: Aid and manifestation supply the focus request and function as the category whose mode the ending specifies.
Expenditure of capacity under hardship supplies the human condition and functions as active participation rather than passivity.
Gentle direction toward path and truth supplies the divine response and functions as navigational aid.
Traversable extended paths supply plural routes forward and function as opened movement beyond blockage.
Doing the good supplies the accompanied agent and functions as the ethical quality in which divine presence is realized.

structural_cues: The closing ayah forms an explicit effort-to-guidance relation and ends with God being with doers of good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies effort, promised guidance, paths, and accompaniment; I infer these as a modal realization of requested aid. A live alternative is that the closing promise is a general epilogue rather than a retrospective specification of 29:30.

changed_reading.before: Aid arrives wholly from outside and replaces the speaker's agency.
changed_reading.after: Aid may guide strenuous agency into open paths and sustain it through divine accompaniment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it takes the focus root's explicit rain-succor branch materially across distant water scenes. It remains anchored in the focus imperative and corruption predicate, and the packet supplies both encircling flood with separated rescue and descending water that revives dead earth. Render it as an ecological analogy for calibrated intervention, not as a claim that Lot literally asks for rain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus branch for support as rain and relief can make help a material force that either clears destructive disorder or restores dead ground.

activation_trace.role: Rain and succor supply the focus root's hydrological branch and function as the material bridge across destructive and restorative water scenes.
Loss of soundness supplies the focus damage-state and functions as what calibrated intervention reverses.
An encircling flood supplies overwhelming water and functions as the destructive pole of intervention.
Escape by separation supplies the preserved outcome and functions as containment within the flood scene.
A vessel cutting the water's face supplies the transport medium and functions as preserved passage through destructive water.
Causing something to descend and arrive supplies the later water movement and functions as benevolent delivery.
Conveying water by pouring or irrigation supplies material replenishment and functions as the restorative pole.
Earth's life through rain and growth supplies the result and functions as restoration after depletion.
Soft growing earth supplies the receptive substrate and functions as the social-order analogy's restored field.
Dead land without life supplies the prior state and functions as a material analogue for corrupted unsoundness.

changed_reading.before: Support is exclusively military or juridical force.
changed_reading.after: Support can be imagined as calibrated water: overwhelming a destructive order, preserving a passage through it, or returning life to what corruption has made dead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses the q-w-m root from the focus noun 'people' to the later command to establish, then links prayer to the exact indecency and wrong named in Lot's episode. The recurrence keeps it anchored, but render it as a whole-surah counter-practice activated by wordplay and repetition, not as the direct lexical meaning of 'people.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's collective and corruption terms are reconfigured when the same q-w-m root establishes a practice said to restrain the same indecency and public wrong.

activation_trace.role: A human collective supplies the opposed body and functions as the social form whose alternative is sought.
Departure from soundness supplies the collective's predicate and functions as the condition a counter-practice must inhibit.
Manifest ugliness supplies the first named Lot-episode offense and functions as one target of the later restraint.
Repellent wrong supplies the public-assembly offense and functions as the second target echoed later.
Standing over an affair in care and maintenance supplies the establishment branch and functions as construction of a durable counter-order.
The specified worship supplies the maintained practice and functions as the counter-order's discipline.
Restraint and prevention supply the causal action and function as internal inhibition rather than external destruction.
The repeated manifest ugliness supplies an exact lexical echo and functions as evidence that the discipline addresses the Lot-pattern.
The repeated repellent wrong supplies the second exact echo and functions as evidence that public corruption has an internal countermeasure.

changed_reading.before: Help against a corrupt collective must destroy an external social body.
changed_reading.after: A counter-community can be made to stand by maintaining a practice that internally restrains the same indecency and public wrong.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it applies the later voyagers' unstable crisis devotion as an audit of the focus's spoken prayer. It remains anchored in 'he said, my Lord' and the later call-purification-rescue-relapse sequence. It must not be rendered as suspicion of Lot; it only warns that the formula of crisis invocation is not self-authenticating apart from the speaker's sustained conduct.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus begins with an uttered appeal, while the later ship scene distinguishes sincere crisis speech from durable post-rescue allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Spoken articulation supplies the focus prayer's observable form and functions as the form whose evidentiary sufficiency is tested.
Calling by speech supplies the crisis invocation and functions as the focus utterance's formal analogue.
Exclusive separation from association supplies momentary purity and functions as evidence that immediate sincerity can be real.
Escape by separation supplies successful rescue and functions as the transition that tests whether invocation endures.
Association with God supplies the post-rescue reversal and functions as evidence that crisis sincerity need not persist.

changed_reading.before: The words 'my Lord, help me' by themselves authenticate the speaker's stable alignment.
changed_reading.after: Crisis invocation may be sincere yet transient, so the focus prayer's credibility rests on the narrative speaker's sustained stance, not on its formula alone.

strongest_changes: The immediate challenge-prayer-announcement sequence turns support into sovereign adjudication that destroys and rescues selectively rather than reversing two homogeneous blocs.
Path cutting, public normalization, and the repeated corrupter label recast the opposed people as a conduct-defined network; later best-form engagement constrains opposition to active wrongdoing.
The surah broadens help beyond immediate force into exposure of false shelter, sovereign timing, protected space, and guided pathmaking through strenuous agency.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus prayer a hinge between a demanded proof and differentiated outcomes, while distant root recurrences activated nonviolent counter-order, hydrological restoration, protected-space, and crisis-speech audits that the immediate episode alone would not supply.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from the focus petition to the messengers' following declarations is strongly suggested by adjacency but not explicitly marked.
The rain-succor and q-w-m/establish-prayer models are branch-backed cross-domain activations and should remain contained rather than promoted to direct glosses.
The later dialogue, timing, sanctuary, and guidance passages may qualify the prayer's possibilities without all being intended retrospective explanations of it.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Aid requested as redress.** ن ص ر B001 is aid that makes someone prevail, while B002 is redress after oppression. The plea follows blocked paths, public wrong, and rejection of warning, and it is directed “against” the corrupting people. I infer that ordinary corrective channels have been exhausted; help reads as judicial redress that restores a violated order, not private advantage.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:40 answers the brief plea with differentiated modes of taking, each attached to wrongdoing. The later catalog confirms redress as restoration through measured consequence, not undirected victory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The appeal asks for redress that restores a corrupted order.** Lexical evidence: `رَبِّ`, root `ر ب ب`, `B002` (repair, nurture, and completion); `ٱنصُرْنِى`, root `ن ص ر`, `B002` (redress after oppression); and `ٱلْمُفْسِدِين`, root `ف س د`, `B001` (departure from soundness and balance). Structural cue: `29:29` has shown bodies, road, and council all disordered; `29:31-35` answer with selective rescue, ruin, and a clear retained sign. Assigned role: lordly repair defines the end, redress supplies the intervention, and corruption names the system needing correction. Abductive move: the packet does not say exactly how help will repair; I infer from the response sequence that redress can separate salvageable relations from a system whose balance is no longer recoverable. Reading change: “help me” becomes a request for restorative adjudication, not merely personal victory.

2. **The singular prayer transfers agency without prescribing the instrument.** Lexical evidence: `قَالَ`, root `ق و ل`, `B001` (uttered speech); `ٱنصُرْنِى`, root `ن ص ر`, `B001` (aid that makes someone prevail); and `قَوْم`, root `ق و م`, `B001` (group of people). Structural cue: the community's prior collective dare is answered by Lot's brief singular address, and the following response arrives through messengers rather than Lot's own force. Assigned role: prayer names the needed outcome while leaving the causal means to the Lord. Abductive move: I infer from the lack of specified tactic and the messenger sequence that the appeal relinquishes control over the form of aid. Reading change: the ayah reads as precise dependence rather than a call to self-authorized retaliation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later confirmation (`29:40`):** The answer to Lot's unspecific appeal is a set of differentiated seizures coupled with denial of divine wrong placement. This clarifies redress as measured restoration of moral order, not indiscriminate force or a mirror of the community's own violence.

baseline.text: O, "Rabbim! Bozgunculuk yapan bu halka karşı bana yardım et" dedi.

findings.text: İstenen yardım, kişisel üstünlükten çok bozulan düzeni haksızlıktan sonra yeniden doğrultan bir giderimdir.
Kısa ve tekil dua sonucu ister fakat aracını belirlemez; böylece uygulama biçimini Rabb'e bırakır.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Instruction on modest conduct and lowering the voice does not clarify the appeal against corrupting people.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its call for God-consciousness and upright speech offers only a general ethical counterpoint to corruption.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats the same prayer as 23:26, but adds no further element after that first exact parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediately preceding accusation establishes the grave conduct of Lot's people that motivates the focus appeal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Moses' identification as a messenger from the Lord supplies a remote prophetic setting but no appeal or corruption judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Moses asks the Lord to separate him from a defiantly sinful people, a close prayer for distinction from a corrupt community.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Creation in truth gives a broad moral ground but does not specifically explain requested help against the people.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The closing praise of the blessed does not add to the focus's appeal, opposition, or corrupting community.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Moses' pledge not to support criminals shows the practical allegiance opposite to aiding corruption.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The bare mention of Lot's people supplies no interpretive development beyond the local narrative already present.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: A prayer that the Lord receive worship is a generic invocation without the focus's conflict or requested help.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Moses asks for rescue from a wrongful people, illuminating appeal to the Lord amid danger from a community.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The verse immediately before the focus records the people's defiant demand for punishment after their public wrongdoing is named.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It denies false claimants any power to avert harm or provide help, sharpening why aid must be sought from the Lord.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly identifies persistent rebellion with being among the corruptors, directly clarifying the focus's designation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The preserved clear sign from the destroyed settlement gives the later memorial outcome of the local appeal and judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Lord is sufficient as guide and helper when messengers face criminal enemies, a broader counterpart to the prayer.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contains a direct communal prayer for help against opponents, though the focus on corruption has already been established more closely.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its pattern of respite and seizure after rejection offers background for judgment but no direct explanation of the appeal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It portrays oppression and social division as corruption, concretizing the kind of public disorder opposed in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God does not set right the work of corruptors, directly linking corruption to divine reversal rather than support.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate next announcement of the settlement's destruction identifies its inhabitants as wrongdoers and begins the answer to Lot's plea.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The question about why people cannot help one another exposes the failure of collective support under judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A prayer for forgiveness, steadfastness, and help against opponents parallels the form of seeking divine aid, but less specifically.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate assurance that Lot and his household will be rescued gives a concrete first stage of the focus prayer's answer.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It names people as corruptors while noting their lack of awareness, sharpening the moral diagnosis in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Moses is commanded to reform and not follow the path of corruptors, an explicit positive alternative to the focus's opposing community.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Respite followed by seizure of a wrongful town shows how delayed judgment can answer entrenched public wrongdoing.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Knowing denial joined to wrongdoing and arrogance ends in the fate of corruptors, adding an accountability pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate reassurance of rescue for Lot and his household continues the answer to the appeal against the settlement.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It condemns repeated efforts to spread corruption and shows God frustrating destructive public escalation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its warning about fragile protectors besides God loosely reinforces reliance on the Lord rather than other support.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The declaration that God's servants are helped is a broad and now redundant confirmation of divine support.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı sesle ortaya çıkarılan söz ve harflerden kurulu sözlü ifade olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve aynı çekirdeği taşıyor; dil organı, hükümdar unvanı ve mecazi yan kullanımlar bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çıplak söz söyleme ve söylenmiş söz çekirdeğidir; organ, unvan, söylenti ve mecazlar ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bare olduğu için tanım çıplak söyleme ve sözlü ifade anlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşünceyi veya sözü sesli biçimde dışa vurma ve böyle dışa vurulmuş harfli sözlü ifade anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
Söylenen şey tek söz, cümle, şiir veya konuşma ölçeğinde olabilir.
Ad biçimleri aynı söylenmiş söz alanında toplanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sözü sesle dışa çıkarılan ve harflerden oluşan sözlü ifade çekirdeğinde toplar; ad biçimleri de aynı alana bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözü sesli biçimde ortaya koyma ve ortaya konmuş sözlü ifade için genel başlık olarak uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sesle dışa vurma ve sözlü ifade çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Fiil bağlamında kişinin sözü sesli olarak ortaya koymasını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Fiilsel söyleme işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ad bağlamında söylenmiş söz veya konuşma ürünü için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Söylenmiş ifade sonucunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sözün sesle dışa vurulmasını ve söylenmiş ifadeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal konuşmayı sağlayan organ olan dili adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de konuşma alanına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Okur karışıklığı söz ile onu üreten organ arasındadır. Bu dalda ürün ve eylem merkezdir; komşuda bedensel araç merkezdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal hem söyleme eylemini hem de söylenmiş söz adlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal konuşmanın dille çıkarılıp lafza dönüşmesi üzerinde durur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de sözün sesli hale gelmesini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu daha doğrudan telaffuz olayına odaklanır; bu dalda söylenmiş sözün ad alanı da çekirdeğe dahildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bir sözün söylenmesini veya söylenmiş olmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sözün insanlar arasında yayılıp söylentiye dönüşmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinde de söylenen söz bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda yayılma şart değildir; komşu dalda sözün dolaşıma girmesi anlamın asli sınırıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşular konuşma, dil, fasıhlık, unvan ve yan kullanımlar alanından tarandı; yayımlanan ayrımlar en yakın sınır karışıklıklarını verir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قال يقول قولا، والقول والقيل، والكلام المركب من الحروف إذا أبرز بالنطق، مفردا كان أو جملة أو قصيدة أو خطبة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه اللسان نفسه، ولا لقب القيل الحميري، ولا الدلالة غير اللفظية إلا في فروعها الخاصة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: القول من النطق (maqayis)؛ قال يقول قولا وقولة ومقالا ومقالة (sihah)؛ القول والقيل واحد (mufradat)؛ المركب من الحروف المبرز بالنطق (mufradat)؛ القيل من القول اسم (ayn)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ilgili biçimi doğrudan konuşma organı olan dil diye açıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu organ anlamını doğru taşır ve söylenmiş söz ya da söz sahibi anlamlarını bu dalın dışında bırakır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal organ adıdır; sözün kendisini, konuşma eylemini veya unvan sahibini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bare olduğu için tanım, tek biçimin çıplak organ anlamına bağlı kalır.

concept_map.definition: Söz söylemeye araç olan konuşma organı, yani dil anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, konuşmayı sağlayan bedensel organdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı konuşma organı olan dil anlamında ortaklaştırır; söz veya unvan anlamı eklenmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözün kendisi değil, sözü çıkaran bedensel araç kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Organ anlamını ve konuşma işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Organ adı olarak doğal çeviridir; bağlam konuşma eylemini değil organı göstermelidir.

error_profile.preserves: Türkçedeki organ adını korur.
error_profile.adds: Türkçede aynı kelime konuşulan sistem anlamını da çağırabilir.
error_profile.collision: Dil kelimesi dil sistemiyle karışabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal konuşmanın organını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sözü söyleme eylemini ve söylenmiş ifadeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de konuşma ve söz alanında bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal araçtır; komşu dal bu araçla çıkan söz veya söyleme işlemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal tek özel biçimin söz organı anlamını verir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal organın genel adı, gücü, cinsiyeti ve çoğulları gibi daha geniş ad alanını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de bedensel konuşma organını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Anlam merkezleri örtüşür; komşu dal organ adının daha geniş sözlük ailesini kapsadığı için sınır tam değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal konuşma organının kendisini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal konuşamama veya konuşmanın tutulması durumunu belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de konuşma yetisiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Organ adı ile konuşma yokluğu aynı alanı paylaşır, fakat birinin çekirdeği araç, diğerinin çekirdeği yoksunluktur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşular organ, konuşma bozukluğu, ses ve ana kök dalları açısından değerlendirildi; en doğrudan organ-karşıtlıkları yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المقول بمعنى اللسان.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه القول المنطوق نفسه ولا صاحب القول.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المقول اللسان (maqayis;ayn;sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi çok sözlü, güzel konuşan veya dili güçlü biri olarak niteleyen adları bir araya getirir. Bu, bir kez söyleme eylemi değil, kişide yerleşik konuşkanlık veya söz becerisi niteliğidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kişi niteliğidir; tekil söyleme eylemi veya insanlar arasında yayılan söylenti değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam non_bare olduğu için tanım, kişi niteleyen özel biçimlerle sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi çok konuşan, dili güçlü veya söz söylemede atak olarak niteleyen kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, kişide söz söyleme çokluğu veya söz becerisi niteliğidir.
Nitelik özellikle insan için kullanılır ve tek bir söyleme olayını göstermez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı kişiyi çok sözlü, dili güçlü veya konuşkan diye niteleyen biçimler etrafında ortaklaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin konuşkanlığı veya söz söyleme gücü nitelendiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişi niteliğini ve söz çokluğunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişi hakkında çok söz söyleme niteliği vurgulandığında doğal çeviridir.

error_profile.preserves: Söz çokluğu niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dilin güçlü veya etkili oluşu ayrıca söylenmeyebilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz becerisi ve etkili konuşma yönü öne çıktığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Söz söyleme gücü niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sadece konuşma çokluğu yönünü ikinci plana iter.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kişinin yerleşik konuşkanlık veya söz becerisi niteliğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal söyleme eylemi ve söylenmiş sözün kendisidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de söz söyleme alanından gelir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kişiyi tanımlar; komşu dal kişinin niteliğini değil eylemi veya ürünü tanımlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal çok sözlülük ve konuşkanlık tarafını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal keskin, gürültülü veya çoğu kez olumsuz bir dil niteliği taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de insanın dil ve söz gücü niteliğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yakınlık konuşma gücündedir; komşuda sertlik ve olumsuz ton belirginleşirken bu dalda çok söz söyleme çekirdeği daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal genel konuşkan veya dili güçlü kişi niteliğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle hitabeti güçlü kişiyi belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de söz söyleme becerisine bağlı kişi niteliğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu daha mesleki veya gösterişli hitabete yaklaşır; bu dal sıradan çok sözlülüğü de içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşular konuşma becerisi, fasıhlık, sert dil ve kişi niteliği açısından tarandı; en yakın kişi nitelemeleri seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قولة وقوال وقوالة وتقوالة وقؤول ومقوال ومقول إذا وصفت الإنسان بأنه لسن أو كثير القول أو منطيق.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.

İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القلة قلة الجبل وهي القطعة تستدير في أعلاه وهي القنة (jamhara)؛ القلة أعلى الجبل؛ قلة كل شيء أعلاه؛ رأس الإنسان قلة (sihah)؛ قلة كل شيء رأسه؛ قلة الجبل أعلاه؛ قبيعة السيف قلته؛ سيف مقلل (tahdhib)؛ قلة الجبل شعفه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Küpe benzeyen iri kabı adlandıran temel ve en doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın küp türünde ve olağandan büyük oluşunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın özellikle su alması ve büyük kapasitesi öne çıkarıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük kabı ve kaynakta belirtilen su taşıma kapasitesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kabın kendisinden çok onların aldığı sıvı miktarı ölçü olarak kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki büyük kabın kapasitesine dayanan ölçü kullanımını tam olarak korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iki büyük küp veya bunların aldığı miktar

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol büyük kap adını iki kaplık bir kapasite ölçüsüne de taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol iri küpün yanı sıra küpün yerleştirildiği tahta destekleri de kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da çok büyük bir küpü veya fıçımsı saklama kabını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kap nesnesinde güçlü bir örtüşme vardır; bu kol ölçü değerine uzanırken komşu kol kabın yerleştirildiği desteği de kapsayan farklı bir sınır kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol kabın özellikle iri oluşunu ve iki kaplık ölçü değerini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol genel bir küp veya saklama kabını büyüklük koşulu olmadan adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da küp biçimindeki büyükçe saklama kapları için kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda büyük kapasite kurucu bir özelliktir; komşu kartta kap türü öndedir ve aynı ölçü uzantısı bulunmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol büyük bir küpü ve ona dayalı kapasite ölçüsünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol bir şeyin başını, tepesini veya en üst bölümünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri hacimli bir kap ve onun ölçüsüdür; diğeri bir varlığın uzamsal olarak en üstteki parçasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; büyük küp anlamına en yakın iki kap komşusu ile aynı kökteki tepe anlamından ayrım, sınırı göstermek için yeterli ve yinelenmeyen karşılaştırmalardır.
branches.what_is_ar: القُلَّة إناء كالجرة الكبيرة، ومنها قلال هجر والحباب العظام
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس قلة العدد، وليس رأس الجبل
branches.source_phrase_ar: القلة التي جاءت في الحديث مثل قلال هجر هي جرار عظام (jamhara)؛ القلة إناء للعرب كالجرة الكبيرة؛ قلال هجر شبيهة بالحباب (sihah)؛ قلتين يعني هذه الحباب العظام واحدتها قلة؛ قلال هجر؛ القلة منها تأخذ مزادة من الماء (tahdhib)؛ القلة ما أقله الإنسان من جرة وحب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma
concept_gloss.applicability: Taşıma, yukarı kalkma ve yüklenerek hareket etme çizgilerinin birlikte özetlenmesi gereken kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yük üstlenme, yükselme ve yolculuk için harekete geçme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya başka bir taşıyıcının bir nesnenin ağırlığını üstlenmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yükü kaldırma gücü ile onu fiilen taşıma anlamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Göğün yükselmesi veya kuşun uçuşa kalkması gibi yukarı yönlü hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarı kalkma ile uçuş için yerden ayrılma değerlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun yolculuk yüklerini alarak bulunduğu yerden ayrılması bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yük alma, ayrılma ve yolculuğa başlama aşamalarını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yükü taşımanın yanında yükselme, havalanma ve yüklenerek ayrılma anlamlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yükü taşıma eyleminden çok onu taşıyacak güce sahip olmayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yükün ağırlığını karşılayacak gücü ve taşıma yeterliğini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Taşıma yeterliği ortak olsa da bu kol fiilî taşıma ve yerden yükselme yönlerine açılır; komşu kol güç yetirme sınırında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yük üstlenmeyi, kuşun havalanmasını ve yolcuların yüklenerek ayrılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol kişinin oturduğu yerden kalkmasını ve bir nesneyi bulunduğu yerden kaldırmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da aşağıdaki veya durağan bir konumdan kalkma ve hareket başlangıcını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yükselmeyi taşıma ve yolculukla bağlar; komşu kol bedensel olarak ayağa kalkma ve nesneyi yerinden kaldırma çevresindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda yolculuk anlamı yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılmasıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yol üzerinde ilerlemeyi ve belirli bir hedefe doğru seyahat etmeyi genel olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlama durumunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol başlangıçtaki yüklenme ve kalkış anını anlatır; komşu kol yolculuğun kendisini ve hedefe doğru ilerlemeyi çekirdek edinir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; taşıma gücü, yerden kalkma ve yolculuğa başlama komşuları bu kolun üç kurucu yönünü en az yinelemeyle açıklar.
branches.what_is_ar: حمل الشيء واحتماله، وارتفاعه أو نهوضه، وارتحال القوم ظاعنين
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد القلة العددية، ولا قلة الجبل، ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أقل الجرة أطاق حملها؛ استقلت السماء ارتفعت؛ استقل القوم مضوا وارتحلوا (sihah)؛ أقل الرجل الشيء واستقله إذا احتمله؛ استقل الطائر إذا نهض للطيران؛ استقل النبات أناف؛ استقل القوم إذا احتملوا ظاعنين؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي حملت؛ قل إذا رفع وقل إذا علا (tahdhib)؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي احتملته؛ أقللت كذا وجدته قليل المحمل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Titremenin kişiyi birden tutan belirgin bir durum olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Titremenin kişiyi tutan bedensel bir olay olarak sunuluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol titremenin korku veya öfkeden doğmasını anlam sınırının parçası yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insandaki titreme veya silkinişi belirli bir duygusal nedenle sınırlamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insan bedeninde ortaya çıkan titreme veya silkinişi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bedensel olay aynıdır; bu kol korku ve öfke koşulunu taşırken komşu kart neden bakımından daha genel kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol korkunun yanında öfkeyi de titremenin belirleyici nedeni olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol hastalık, gevşeklik, yumuşaklık ve korkaklıkla ilişkili titremeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da özellikle korku sırasında insanda görülen titreme ve ürpermede örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Korkuya bağlı kullanımda yakınlaşırlar; bu kol öfkeyi ekler, komşu kol ise hastalık ve bedensel gevşeklik gibi başka nedenlere açılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel insan titremesi ve nedenleri daha geniş ürperme alanı, bu kolun kişi ve duygu sınırını en iyi gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir nesneyi hareket ettirerek onun oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit kalamama ile düzensiz sallanma durumunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sallanan veya oynayan nesnenin çıkardığı sesin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin genel bir ses değil, hareketten doğan işitsel belirti oluşunu korur.
